fields.value: Evaluate LLM-based players, self-hosted and hosted

Run experiments whose players are language models: ones we serve ourselves and, especially, ones hosted behind OpenRouter or a similar service. This may need changes beyond EXP-66's eval API.

Jack Heart, 2026-11-14: "Perhaps enabling the experiments we did with LLM-based players (both LMs that we run but especially LMs that are hosted behind OpenRouter or similar) may require additional changes and that can be a \[follow-up\] task."

Context: the Manabot session (MTG-329) is writing eval-only experiment files that play an LLM (Claude through an API, Qwen on a served model) against the final checkpoint of an earlier experiment, and said a fuller list of gaps found while writing them would follow. EXP-66 covers eval-only experiments, checkpoints from other experiments, and one inference server per machine for checkpoint players.

Open: how a hosted model is a player (no checkpoint to load; credentials, rate limits, cost per call, non-determinism, retries); whether a self-served LLM uses EXP-66's inference server; what the eval records store about a hosted model's identity and version.
